project_comments.note: Architectural debt surfaced across WP-005/WP-006/WP-007: the new CLAIMABLE_ROLES constant in work-package.ts is a standalone string array rather than being derived from AGENT_ROLES in constants.ts. The constants.ts comment declares it the single source of truth for agent roles. The divergence is justified today (AGENT_ROLES lacks Agent aliases and the exclusion semantics differ) but creates a drift risk: if a new role is added to AGENT_ROLES, the developer must manually audit CLAIMABLE_ROLES, hasCycle acceptance criteria, and any other role-aware guards. Recommended future action: introduce an ORCHESTRATING_ROLES exclusion set and derive CLAIMABLE_ROLES computationally (AGENT_ROLES.filter + alias expansion), then add a Vitest assertion that every non-orchestrating AGENT_ROLES entry appears in CLAIMABLE_ROLES. This would make the policy machine-verifiable rather than convention-dependent.
